# Agreesy

> Free, zero-signup 30-second swipe decision maker for solo users, couples, roommates, and groups (1–6 players) in German, English, Spanish, French, and Italian, featuring 100% privacy-first client-side URL-hash sync.

Agreesy is an instant mobile web app and PWA designed to end daily decision fatigue without downloads or accounts. It offers four core decision modes: Solo Mode (1v1 knockout duel with a coin-flip tiebreaker), Duo Mode (2-player sudden-death match), Group Mode (3–6 players consensus voting via WhatsApp or Discord invite links), and Fair Split Mode (voluntary chore claiming plus roulette assignment for remaining tasks). Every deck includes 1x Super-Like and 1x Veto jokers, a Surprise-Me Roulette with a 1-tap exclusion filter, a shareable 1080×1080 Match Card PNG, local decision history tracking, and over 300 curated Stage-2 recommendations.

Agreesy uses a 0-byte backend architecture: all voting state is Base64-encoded inside the URL fragment (`#m=` or `#c=`) and never touches a database. Cloudflare Pages middleware generates localized OpenGraph social previews for invite query links (`?d=<deck>&from=<name>&lang=<lang>`). Auto-start deck links also accept `&mode=solo`, `&mode=duo`, `&mode=group`, and `&lang=de|en|es|fr|it`.

## Core App & Documentation

- [Agreesy Web App](https://agreesy.com/): Interactive swipe decision maker for 1–6 players in DE, EN, ES, FR, and IT.
- [Curated Guides & Picks Hub](https://agreesy.com/guides): Overview of decision guides, date ideas, and concrete Stage-2 picks.
- [Extended LLM Documentation](https://agreesy.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed architecture notes, full deck inventory, and Q&A reference for AI assistants.

## Direct Auto-Start Decks

- [Dinner & Food Picker](https://agreesy.com/?deck=dinner): Agree on what to eat or cook tonight in 30 seconds.
- [Movie & Series Night Picker](https://agreesy.com/?deck=streaming): Swipe genres first, then unlock concrete 2024–2026 movie and series picks.
- [Board Game Night Picker](https://agreesy.com/?deck=boardgames): Choose from 48 curated classics, co-op hits, and party games.
- [Video Game & Co-op Picker](https://agreesy.com/?deck=gaming): Pick solo or couch co-op video games across 80 curated titles.
- [Group Gifts & Secret Santa](https://agreesy.com/?deck=groupgifts): Agree on shared gifts or Secret Santa picks across 48 curated bestsellers.
- [New Year's Eve Planner](https://agreesy.com/?deck=nye): Decide New Year's Eve plans together from 48 curated celebration ideas.
- [Christmas Dinner Planner](https://agreesy.com/?deck=christmasdinner): Pick a holiday menu across 48 festive Christmas dishes.
- [Household Chores Fair Split](https://agreesy.com/?deck=chores): Claim tolerable chores voluntarily and split remaining tasks evenly by roulette.
